title: National Underground Railroad Freedom Center

services.name: Schedule a Tour
services.desc: Book your field trip today using the form at the bottom of this page! You will receive an email confirmation within 48-72 hours. The Freedom Center is a preeminent cultural and educational learning center committed to pursuing inclusive freedom and promoting social justice for all. Through our field trip bookings, we aim to provide the necessary information to facilitate conversations with your students about slavery and injustice in our culture and society, as well as inspire and teach how to apply the principles and methods of the Underground Railroad While all field trips are self-guided, we do provide a short orientation at the start of your visit, as well as educator-designed materials
